# netactuate_nke_storage_addon (Resource)

Manages a NKE Storage Addon.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_nke_storage_addon" "example" {
  cluster_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The NKE cluster ID

### Optional

- `block_namespace_id` (Number) Existing storage block namespace ID to attach, or the one the API assigned
- `capacity` (Number) Storage capacity in GB
- `channel` (String) Addon channel
- `enable_auto_scaling` (Boolean) Enable storage auto scaling
- `make_default` (Boolean) Make this the default storage class
- `pool_label` (String) Storage pool label
- `reclaim_policy` (String) Kubernetes reclaim policy
- `storage_class_name` (String) Kubernetes storage class name
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `version` (String) Addon version

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Addon display name
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `installed_on` (String) Addon installation timestamp
- `state` (String) Addon state
- `storage_integration_id` (Number) The id of the StorageClass binding the addon created
- `update_available` (Boolean) Whether an addon update is available
- `volume_snapshot_class_name` (String) The VolumeSnapshotClass name, if the addon reports one

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>

- `create` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_nke_storage_addon.example 12345
```
